homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym, and T composes no other entity under the name. 'CSNTM' is the census's other name for the entity (RF-01); csntm.org, manuscripts.csntm.org and new.csntm.org (a host of the center's own site in search results) are its hosts. No other bearer of the name or the abbreviation appeared in the cards or the searches.
distinct_entities: Daniel B. Wallace, its founder and Executive Director (a person; danielbwallace.com is his own site, linked from B6)
Michael W. Holmes, Chairman of the Board (Wikipedia infobox, B2 F19; a person)
the Center for the Research of Early Christian Documents, its parent organization (B2 F19), an entity distinct from it
the Institute for New Testament Textual Research (INTF), Münster, keeper of the official catalogue and the critical editions (B1 F12; B6 F33)
the Chester Beatty Library, Dublin, holding institution of P45, P46 (with the University of Michigan) and P47 (B8 F45, F46; B2 F22)
Hendrickson, the publisher of the P45–P47 facsimile (B1 F11)
the Scribal Fellowship, the center's monthly-giving community (B7 F35), a programme of the entity, not a second entity
Associates for Biblical Research (B6) and North Texas Giving Day, Communities Foundation of Texas (B5), the publishers of two cards

captures.q: Center for the Study of New Testament Manuscripts
captures.description: THE CENTER FOR THE STUDY OF NEW TESTAMENT MANUSCRIPTS, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a non-profit organization dedicated to digitally preserving surviving Greek New Testament manuscripts.' Founder (Daniel B. Wallace, September 2002), location (Plano, Texas), mission, access ('freely available to scholars, researchers, and the public online'), the digitization record and 'nearly 90 previously unknown or uncatalogued Greek New Testament manuscripts'. Six cards: the center's own site, Wikipedia, Facebook, LinkedIn, North Texas Giving Day, the Associates for Biblical Research.
